lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Cutey,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: random question.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Which do you think would happen first? Laplace not breaking a window,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: or me replacing every window in the Ark with super-reinforced glass?
Laplace not breaking a window.
Replacing all the windows with super-reinforced glass.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You've been around Laplace for so long and still don't get it?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Not a day goes by when she doesn't break a window...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You think so too, right, Cutey?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Heh, that's what pretty much everyone says.
Why? Did Laplace break another window?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Breaking windows is practically a daily occurrence.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I was just thinking...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What if Laplace made an entrance without breaking a window?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: We'd have to send her to a hospital

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: instead of a battlefield.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Actually, no.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: If she stopped breaking windows,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: she'd probably start saying there's no way a hero could fail to break one...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: and spiral into depression.
That's a fair point.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hahaha, right?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Every now and then, I start imagining the most absurd things.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What about you, Cutey?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Do you ever have those kinds of wild fantasies?
Yeah, I do.
Like wondering which'll happen first: Anis giving up soda,
or Neon giving up her obsession with firepower?
You know, stuff like that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Wow, that's actually a pretty close match.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hahahaha, that's hilarious.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Whenever I'm stuck and can't come up with anything,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I start imagining stuff like this and get a little laugh out of it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Then it feels like my brain starts working again,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: you know?
Yeah.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: To be honest, today was just one of those days.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: But thanks to you,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I feel like my brain's finally starting to work again.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Thanks, Cutey.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I'd better get back to my research now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I'll text you if I come up with anything interesting.
